hero.name: Amay Shah
hero.title: Technical Program Manager
hero.tagline: Technical Program Manager who bridges product vision and engineering execution to deliver high-impact AI and software solutions. Experienced across the full SDLC—from PRD design and cross-functional team alignment to third-party integrations and production releases. Pragmatic Agile lead skilled in sprint delivery, backlog refinement, user experience reviews, and data-driven decision-making across AWS and Azure.

highlights.label: Cloud Spend ↓
highlights.description: Idle workloads cut on AWS & Azure

bullets: Own and drive the technical product roadmap for AI/ML-powered FinOps solutions—including cost recommendation engines, anomaly detection, predictive forecasting models, and an AI chatbot—translating business requirements and PRDs into technical specifications, architectural milestones, and production releases from inception to deployment.

Lead Agile/Scrum delivery across 4 concurrent workstreams for 40+ distributed engineers and QA across multiple time zones; run 1-week sprint cadences, facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot complex implementation issues, and actively remove blockers to accelerate delivery cycles.

Champion metric development and operational reporting by building Power BI tracking dashboards to monitor project health, delivery milestones, and complex feature requirements, directly aligning technical deliverables with broader platform value and customer onboarding goals.

Direct release management, CI/CD pipeline coordination, and third-party systems integrations, shipping 4+ zero-downtime production releases monthly with seamless progression across UAT, staging, and multi-region production environments.

Manage multi-cloud infrastructure budgets, resource allocation, and technical risk mitigation across workstreams; optimize compute across AWS and Azure to eliminate idle workloads and cut operational cloud spend by 15–20%.

Conduct competitive benchmarking and technical architecture reviews to guide feature feasibility, engineering prioritization, and go-to-market readiness, ensuring scalable system workflows that meet enterprise usability and performance standards.

Execute rigorous UAT and production validation across all platform releases, enterprise integrations, and AI/ML pipelines (invoice parsing, contract processing, forecasting), driving a 20% data integrity gain and predictable deployment cadences.

experience.role: Technical Project Manager — Enterprise Data Warehouse
bullets: Developed and managed end-to-end technical solutions across the full SDLC, establishing shared goals with engineering and product partners to articulate technical milestones and guarantee on-time delivery.

Proactively identified technical risks and deployed mitigation strategies, implementing automated error-handling and rigorous quality assurance controls that reduced operational downtime by 25% and improved data integrity by 20%.
Led cross-functional engineering initiatives to automate weekly server refreshes and infrastructure operations, standardizing deployment workflows to eliminate non-value-add overhead.

Managed cross-functional program execution across multiple workstreams; facilitated technical syncs to resolve complex architecture and implementation blockers, driving continuous delivery momentum across distributed teams.
Designed measurement frameworks and ongoing reporting mechanisms to track delivery milestones and system reliability, proactively communicating critical dependencies and risks to stakeholders.

projects.title: Medical Doc Analyzer
projects.subtitle: AWS NLP Pipeline
bullets: Architected and engineered an end-to-end NLP data pipeline on AWS to analyze medical datasets using Amazon Comprehend.

Automated data ingestion workflows by uploading datasets to Amazon S3 via the AWS CLI, processing and structuring the outputs into standardized JSON payloads, and storing results in DynamoDB for low-latency querying.
Maintained full data dictionary documentation and designed the schema-less storage layer to ensure efficient querying and seamless data retrieval by downstream analytics teams.

Drafted strict documentation for data security and governance, implementing secure IAM inline policies following the principle of least-privilege access alongside mandatory S3 bucket encryption and object versioning for project isolation.

projects.title: AWS-Powered Global Compliance Chatbot
projects.subtitle: Generative AI & RAG
bullets: Authored a comprehensive Product Requirement Document (PRD) and defined the feature scope to build a compliance chatbot utilizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) through Amazon Q Business to deliver country-specific forestry regulation insights.
Designed the underlying data ingestion architecture, utilizing Amazon S3 as a scalable data lake to centralize, version, and manage cross-border compliance documentation.
Mapped out user persona workflows to optimize chatbot prompt accuracy, enabling employees across continents to instantly query multi-country regulations and drastically reduce manual research time.

Created detailed system administration documentation, mapping content-source connectors and data access controls to ensure the chatbot strictly surfaces information based on defined user authorization levels.

projects.title: ETL Pipeline with PySpark API and HDFS
projects.subtitle: Big Data Engineering
bullets: Developed a comprehensive technical specification layout to build a scalable, end-to-end ETL pipeline, configuring a multi-node Apache Hadoop cluster on Oracle Virtual Machines to process large-scale wood product datasets.
Engineered robust PySpark transformation logic to convert raw datasets into highly optimized, compressed Apache Parquet columnar formats within HDFS.

Authored performance optimization runbooks analyzing formats, custom data partitioning strategies, schema enforcement rules, and access patterns to drastically improve query performance and minimize storage costs.
Built technical documentation and performance dashboards to track, analyze, and communicate pipeline efficiency metrics, compute utilization, and data integrity milestones.

projects.title: Obesity Projection Analysis
projects.subtitle: Data Mining & Machine Learning
bullets: Managed the full data lifecycle for a predictive machine learning model to estimate predictions in the Obesity dataset, from establishing initial evaluation metrics to executing feature prioritization and selecting core algorithms.

Spearheaded data preprocessing workflows, feature selection, missing value imputation, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to streamline high-dimensional datasets while documenting feature importance scores.
Orchestrated rigorous model validation across various regression and classification algorithms, thoroughly documenting and achieving high accuracy with a Random Forest Regressor framework.

Leveraged Python libraries including Matplotlib, NumPy, and Pandas to design advanced, management-level data visualizations and analytical reports, translating complex statistical model outputs into clear, intuitive insights.
